get.description: Server owner: today's totals and the budget, the model queue, and the busiest workspaces.

delete.description: Delete every chat that has nothing running. Chats with a running task are left alone.
Delete a whole chat: every task in the thread that contains `tid`, with its steps. Only your own.

post.description:
Stop everything running, then erase this workspace: tasks and their steps, computers, signed-in devices,
learned notes, usage counts and the workspace itself. It cannot be undone.

get.description:
Server-sent events: a `devices` event, then a `task` event whenever a task changes. `once=1` returns the
current snapshot and closes (also a polling fallback for clients that cannot stream).
Everything stored about this workspace as one JSON file (never sign-in tokens, never another workspace).

post.description: Any controller of a workspace can add another controller to the SAME workspace.

get.description: What this workspace has used today, and how busy the shared model queue is.
Public and harmless: which code is this server process running? (Lets anyone compare it with GitHub.)

delete.description: Server owner: erase one workspace for someone who cannot sign in to do it themselves (a data-deletion request).
